Definition: from G688; an Arab or native of Arabia:--Arabian.
BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, on the day of Pentecost, when the crowd hears the disciples speak in their own tongues. The Arabians are named among them, hearing the wonderful works of God in their own language.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Arabians at Pentecost are the proof that no nation is left out of the gospel, because God speaks to each in the tongue they were born to.
